questions.question: At Buffalo Park, who holds the record for 'Most Matches' (List A)?
Cobras set a database record (23/24 season, combined T20 + List A) with a value of 287. Which record is it?
options: Lowest Team Total (all out or completed innings)
questions.explanation: It's the record for 'Highest Team Total', held by Cobras.

questions.question: At which ground did Cobras record their 'Largest Win by Runs' (T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at Recreation Ground — largest win by runs of 109, against Badgers on 2024/12/15.

questions.question: Who holds the record for 'Fastest 50 (by balls)' in the 24/25 season (combined T20 + List A)?
questions.explanation: Tazmin Brits holds it, with a total of 20.

questions.question: At which ground did Dorothy Mathekga record their career-best innings (32, T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at Kimberley Oval, against Heat on 2022/10/30.

questions.question: South Africa Women have only ever won one Test match in their history. Who was the opponent, and in what year?
questions.explanation: South Africa's sole Test victory came against the Netherlands in 2007, the only Test the two sides have ever played against each other.
